title: docs: note partial flag on failed provider turns
claim: A provider/agent failure that already delivered reply text reaches API clients as run.failed with partial: true; the terminal-run-status table must say so.

evidence.source: agent/turn_recovery.py:1092 and :1240 set result["partial"] = True when _with_delivered_partial() keeps already-delivered text (non-retryable and retry-exhausted paths, #119001); gateway/platforms/api_server_runs.py:181 terminal_run_status() emits {"completed": finished, "partial": bool(result.get("partial")), ...} (:193) on every terminal event/status.
evidence.red: Probe on main: terminal_run_status(_failed_turn_result(...) + partial=True) -> ('failed', {'completed': False, 'partial': True, 'interrupted': False}); the doc row lists no partial.
evidence.green: Row now reads "`completed: false`, `error`, `partial` when applicable (e.g. reply text was already streamed before a retry-exhausted or non-retryable provider error)".
evidence.negative_control: Probe without delivered text -> partial False, matching the 'when applicable' qualifier.
